output.objective: Customers can enter a discount code at checkout; the backend applies it and the frontend shows the discounted total
constraints: money stays in integer minor units with an ISO-4217 currency (DECISIONS.md ADR-001)
the frontend reaches the backend only through shared/src (ADR-002)
outcomes: a valid code lowers the checkout total
the checkout page shows the discount line
output.summary: Extend the shared contract and the checkout client, apply codes in the checkout service, and document them, in parallel with disjoint write scopes.
output.rationale: The contract change is small and owned by the frontend task; the backend task reads the contract and learns of its change through Friday, so the three tasks can start at once.

tasks.summary: Discount codes in the shared contract and the checkout client

acceptance_criteria: the discount line shows the amount saved
